question: Net new assets by quarter for each of the five, with each firm's own definition of the metric.
reasoning_content:
The sub-question asks for the firm's own definition of the net new assets metric. Let me identify the definitions.

From SCHW-10K-2025#122: "Net new client assets: Total inflows of client cash and securities to Schwab less client outflows. Inflows include dividends and interest; outflows include commissions and fees. Capital gains distributions are excluded."

From SCHW-10K-2025#119: "Core net new client assets: Net new client assets before significant one-time inflows or outflows... and activity from off-platform brokered CDs issued by CSB."

From SCHW-PR-2026-04-16-01#45: "(2) Net new assets before significant one-time inflows or outflows... and activity from off-platform Schwab Bank Retail CDs."

Also note (1): "differences between net new assets and core net new assets are net flows from off-platform Schwab Bank Retail CDs."

So there are two definitions: "net new client assets" and "core net new client assets."

The sub-question asks for "each firm's own definition of the net new assets metric". So I should provide facts about the definitions.

Let me capture:
1. Net new client assets definition (10-K #122)
2. Core net new client assets definition (10-K #119)
3. The footnote about difference between net new assets and core net new assets (press releases)

These are all facts (the firm's own definitions).

quote: "Net new client assets: Total inflows of client cash and securities to Schwab less client outflows. Inflows include dividends and interest; outflows include commissions and fees. Capital gains distributions are excluded."
No value, unit, period, scope.

Item 1: Core net new client assets definition from 10-K #119.
quote: "Core net new client assets: Net new client assets before significant one-time inflows or outflows, such as acquisitions/divestitures or extraordinary flows (generally greater than $25 billion ($10 billion prior to 2025)) relating to a specific client, and activity from off-platform brokered CDs issued by CSB."

Item 2: From press footnote: "differences between net new assets and core net new assets are net flows from off-platform Schwab Bank Retail CDs."

Also the core net new assets definition as stated in press releases (e.g., #45): "Net new assets before significant one-time inflows or outflows, such as acquisitions/divestitures or extraordinary flows (generally greater than $25 billion) relating to a specific client, and activity from off-platform Schwab Bank Retail CDs. These flows may span multiple reporting periods."
